verses.1: And when he invited his twelve disciples, he gave them the power to breathe impure air. Thus, they could expel evil spirits and heal all kinds of diseases and illnesses.
verses.2: The names of those twelve apostles are as follows: the first was Simon, who was also called Peter; his brother was Andrew. Then there was James, the son of Zebedaeus; and his brother was John.
verses.3: Philip and Bartholomew, Thomas and Mathaias the Teller, Jacob from Alphaius, and Thaddeus.
verses.4: Simon the Canaanite and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.5: These twelve were sent by Jesus, who instructed them, saying: “Do not go into any nations, nor enter the city of Samaria.”
verses.6: But go instead towards the sheep and the lost animals of Israel’s house.
verses.7: And they proclaimed that the kingdom of heaven was near.
verses.8: You heal the sick, raise the dead, purify the wounded, and drive out demons. You receive gifts, and you also give gifts in return.
verses.9: Do not use gold, silver, or copper for your animals.
verses.10: They must not carry any clothes, shoes, or blankets on their journey. After all, the worker deserves to be paid according to the value of his work.
verses.11: When you entered a city or town, ask who is worthy of respect there. Stay there until you leave.
verses.12: And when you entered the house, you took her away with you.
verses.13: And if the house is worthy of being called a home, then let peace come upon it. But if it is not worthy, then let peace return to you.
verses.14: And those who do not obey you or listen to your words, when they leave the house or the city, you should lead them in order to discipline them properly.
verses.15: I say to you, in the days of Sodomon and Gomorrah, there will be a day of judgment either in that city or elsewhere.
verses.16: I see that I am sending you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore, be careful, like the lambs, and strong, like the sheep.
verses.17: But pay attention to those people. They will bring you before the councils, and in their meetings, they will insult you.
verses.18: And on the thrones of kings and rulers, you should be tested by me as a witness for them and for their nations.
verses.19: When they hand you over to us, do not worry about what or how to speak. For in that hour, they will give you permission to speak whatever you want.
verses.20: For it is not you who are speaking, but the spirit of the Father who speaks through you.
verses.21: And he will hand over a brother to death, as well as a father to his son. And the sons will turn against their parents and kill them.
verses.22: And you who are hated by everyone, because of my name, will be saved in the end. But those who remain loyal to me will be saved too.
verses.23: But when they pursue you in this city, then run to the other city. Indeed, I tell you, do not leave the cities of Israel until the Son of Man comes.
verses.24: A student is not a slave to his teacher, nor is a slave to his master.
verses.25: It’s enough for the student to become like his teacher, and for the slave to become like his master. If the ruler of Belzeboul was called upon, then how much more so must those who are under his rule be treated?
verses.26: Do not fear them then. For nothing remains hidden that will not be revealed, and nothing remains secret that will not be known.
verses.27: What I say to you in the dark, say it in the light. And what you hear, proclaim it in the rooms.
verses.28: And do not fear those who destroy the body, but do not let their souls be destroyed either. But fear more those who have the power to destroy both the body and the soul in battle.
verses.29: Are not two baskets of assarion sold? And none of them will fall to the ground without your father’s permission.
verses.30: And all the hairs on your head are also counted.
verses.31: Do not be afraid; you are part of many groups/communities.
verses.32: Therefore, whenever anyone confesses this to me before other people, I also confess it to him before my father who is in heaven.
verses.33: And if anyone were to deny me before the people, then I too will deny him before my father in heaven.
verses.34: Don’t think that we came to bring peace to the land. We didn’t come to bring peace, but war instead.
verses.35: For I came to divide up a man between his father and his mother, his daughter between her mother, and his concubine between his widow.
verses.36: And also the enemies of man: his household members.
verses.37: A loving father or mother is not worthy of me. Nor is a loving son or daughter worthy of me.
verses.38: And he who does not accept his cross and follows me from behind, he is not worthy of me.
verses.39: He who finds his soul will destroy it; and he who destroys his soul will find it through me.
verses.40: The one who accepts you accepts me, and the one who accepts me accepts the person who sent me.
verses.41: Whoever accepts a prophet in the name of a prophet receives a reward as a prophet. And whoever accepts justice in the name of justice receives a reward as a justice.
verses.42: And whoever drinks one of these small cups, just for the sake of honoring the name of the disciple, indeed, I say to you, he must not lose his salary.
